content: I have 3 MFM power meters at 127.0.0.1 port 5020, unit IDs 1, 2 and 3. Each has 10 float32 registers starting at address 0: V_L1, V_L2, V_L3, I_L1, I_L2, I_L3, kW, kVAR, PF, Hz. Set up everything and start logging.

✅ **Plan proposed successfully!** 

**Configuration Summary:**
- **1 Gateway:** MFM-Power-Meters at 127.0.0.1:5020
- **3 Devices:** MFM-Meter-1/2/3 (unit IDs 1, 2, 3)
- **1 Schema:** power_meter_mfm with 10 float32 fields (V_L1-3, I_L1-3, kW, kVAR, PF, Hz)
- **3 Tables:** One per meter with register mappings (addresses 0-18, 2 registers per float32)
- **1 Job:** Polling all 3 meters every 10 seconds

**Register Mapping:**
| Field | Register Address |
|-------|-----------------|
| V_L1  | 0 |
| V_L2  | 2 |
| V_L3  | 4 |
| I_L1  | 6 |
| I_L2  | 8 |
| I_L3  | 10 |
| kW    | 12 |
| kVAR  | 14 |
| PF    | 16 |
| Hz    | 18 |

The **Approve & Execute** and **Discard** buttons are available below. Approve to create all entities and start logging.
The engineer has approved the plan. Execute it now — create all entities in dependency order.

**Created:**
- **Gateway:** MFM-Power-Meters (127.0.0.1:5020)
- **Devices:** MFM-Meter-1/2/3 (unit IDs 1, 2, 3)
- **Schema:** power_meter_mfm (10 float32 fields)
- **Tables:** meter_1_data, meter_2_data, meter_3_data (all migrated)
- **Mappings:** All 10 registers mapped per meter (V_L1-3, I_L1-3, kW, kVAR, PF, Hz)
- **Job:** MFM-Meters-Poll (running, 10s interval)

**Data collection is now active.** The job will poll all 3 meters every 10 seconds and log readings to the database.
